name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Product Marketing | Reputation & Customer Feedback Platforms, Sales Enablement
summary: Marketing and revenue professional with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, including hands-on experience inside the reputation management and customer feedback category at Birdeye. Spent a decade selling software before building the marketing systems behind it, so product messaging gets tested against real buyer objections rather than assumed. Developed sales training used by tenured account executives at Wix, built partner enablement toolkits and product-training content at Birdeye, and now runs a self-directed product marketing motion at Solenzo: a free offer distributed through organic social growth, converting prospects into paying clients. Fast, high-volume writer across decks, guides, and thought leadership.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own a self-directed product marketing motion end to end: positioned a free digital-footprint audit as a top-of-funnel offer, distributed it through organic LinkedIn growth, and converted a share of the 180+ enrolled businesses into paying clients.
Write and publish thought leadership content, newsletters, and educational guides, translating complex technical systems into narratives a business audience acts on.
Draft direct-response copy, decks, and landing pages, and build reusable messaging frameworks adapted per brand and vertical rather than rebuilt each time.
Conduct competitor research and keyword gap analyses that shape content direction and positioning.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' ideas into precise, structured requirements, bridging business intent and technical execution.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led integrated marketing strategy across paid media, inbound, and content, coordinating messaging and execution across internal departments.
Produced conversion-focused campaign assets, including landing pages, email sequences, and copy tested against performance data.

Built product-training content, enablement toolkits, and communication workflows that equipped partners to articulate reputation and review-management value to their own customers.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to route structured, high-priority customer feedback into roadmap decisions - functioning as the voice-of-customer channel this role formalizes.
Analyzed partner utilization and adoption data to identify where the product story and product experience diverged, and recommended interventions that reduced churn.
Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and review-management tools.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed campaign performance at a performance marketing agency and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.
